description: Complete the homepage in shopify-live-horizon/templates/index.json by appending the remaining sections (Shop by Room, Shop by Category/Construction, Bhadohi Story, Brand Statement, Design Consultation, Reviews, Journal, Final CTA) after the existing hero and 'Featured Loom Releases' product-list, matching the Next.js section order in src/app/page.tsx. All sections reuse existing Horizon sections composed via JSON (no new .liquid section unless a layout is impossible via JSON). Bind to real Shopify data; use merchant-editable empty states with NO fabricated reviews/claims where data is absent. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (different template files).
steps: Read context.json first, then read sections/collection-list.liquid, sections/media-with-content.liquid, sections/section.liquid, sections/featured-blog-posts.liquid, and blocks/review.liquid to confirm the exact preset block trees and available block/setting ids before composing JSON.
In templates/index.json, PRESERVE sections hero_jVaWmY and product_list_fa6P9H and keep them first in `order`. Append all new sections after product_list_fa6P9H.

Shop by Room: add a `collection-list` section (copy the collections_grid or collections_editorial preset block tree). Heading text block uses `

Shop by Space & Scale

` with font `var(--font-heading--family)`, case none; add a small uppercase eyebrow `text` block ('Architectural Placement'). Leave `collection_list` empty (merchant picker) so no fake rooms are invented; background `{{ settings.color_palette.background }}`; padding-block ~64/64.

Shop by Category/Construction: add a second `collection-list` section with `

Shop by Collection

`; leave the `collection_list` picker empty with a label guiding the merchant to pick the real Hand-Knotted/Hand-Tufted/Hand-Woven/Hand-Woven Jute collections. Do NOT hardcode handles that may not exist.

Bhadohi Story: add a `media-with-content` section (copy the `editorial` preset). Dark `background_color` `{{ settings.color_palette.foreground }}`, light text; Jost heading `

Bhadohi: The Heart of Indian Rug Weaving

`; rte body with brand-voice copy but NO numeric knot/week claims; merchant image slot (no baked production image URL).

Brand Statement: add a `section` (generic centered container). Eyebrow text block 'The Shukla Rugs Ethos' (uppercase), a large Jost display `text` block with the quote 'Every rug tells a story.', and an rte paragraph of editorial copy with no stats. Centered alignment, generous padding.

Design Consultation: add a `media-with-content` or `section` CTA. Terracotta #BC8A5A literal accent eyebrow; heading + rte; a `button` block linking to `shopify://pages/contact` exposed as a merchant-editable link (verify the real page handle during implementation; default to contact). No fabricated service promises.

Reviews/Social Proof: inspect blocks/review.liquid. If it binds to a real review source (app metafield/metaobject), use it. Otherwise add a merchant-editable, empty-by-default testimonial `section` with text blocks the merchant fills manually and NO default review/rating text, OR omit the section. Record the decision in `findings`.

Journal: add a `featured-blog-posts` section with heading 'Stories on Craft & Materiality'; leave the `blog` setting empty (merchant picker) so a real blog is bound later. The section renders empty placeholders when unset — that is acceptable.
Final CTA: add a `section` with a large Jost heading and a `button` -> `shopify://collections/all` ('Shop All Rugs'). Centered.

Set the top-level `order` array to: hero_jVaWmY, product_list_fa6P9H, shop-by-room, shop-by-category, bhadohi-story, brand-statement, design-consultation, reviews (if added), journal, final-cta — using the actual unique section ids you assign.
Keep brand name exactly 'Shukla Rugs'. Use `{{ settings.color_palette.* }}` tokens and `var(--font-*--family)` fonts throughout; terracotta only as a literal.
acceptance_criteria: templates/index.json still contains hero_jVaWmY and product_list_fa6P9H unchanged and first in `order`.
All eight homepage areas (or seven if Reviews omitted) are present as sections and listed in `order` in the Next.js visual order.
No fabricated reviews, ratings, testimonials, numeric craft claims, or baked production image URLs appear in index.json; data-dependent sections use empty merchant pickers/empty states.
Running `shopify theme check` from shopify-live-horizon introduces zero new errors versus the pre-edit baseline.
templates/index.json is valid JSON after stripping its leading auto-generated comment banner.
verification: cd c:\Users\yashs\Downloads\shuklarugsv1\shopify-live-horizon ; shopify theme check  (confirm no NEW errors vs baseline recorded in findings)

No genuine homepage testimonial/review source exists. NO fabricated review text, author names, star counts, or ratings. Section can be deleted or hidden by the merchant if unused.
